description: Defines classes and structures for managing and traversing a layer hierarchy graph in the Android SurfaceFlinger frontend, including LayerHierarchy, LayerHierarchyBuilder, and related traversal and path management logic.

classes.name: LayerHierarchy
classes.description: Represents a graph of layer nodes with traversal and hierarchy management functionalities.

classes.name: LayerHierarchyBuilder
classes.description: Builds and updates the layer hierarchy graph from a list of RequestedLayerStates.

classes.name: LayerHierarchy::TraversalPath
classes.description: Represents a unique traversal path to a node in the hierarchy, including variant and mirror information.

classes.name: LayerHierarchy::ScopedAddToTraversalPath
classes.description: Helper class to manage adding/removing nodes to/from a traversal path during traversal.

methods.name: LayerHierarchy::traverse
methods.description: Traverses the hierarchy, visiting all nodes via a provided callback.

methods.name: LayerHierarchy::traverseInZOrder
methods.description: Traverses the hierarchy in z-order, skipping relative children.

methods.name: LayerHierarchyBuilder::update
methods.description: Updates the hierarchy with new and destroyed layers.
